definitions: The act of consuming a large quantity of negative online news or social media content, especially on a phone or computer, in a way that feels compulsive or overwhelming.
To spend an excessive amount of time online reading negative or upsetting news.
examples: She couldn't stop herself from doomscrolling late into the night.
Many people doomscroll as a coping mechanism during stressful times.
He found himself doomscrolling through political updates for hours.
